system.description:
Starting at 2nd Level, you have begun to store medical release Chakra into your muscles, prepping them for when it is time to release it in a single burst. This stored power is manifested as Byakugou Seals, represented as d12’s, of which you have 4. You regain 1 Byakugou Seal when you score a critical hit with a melee unarmed or Taijutsu attack, once per turn. You regain all spent seals when you spend 10 minutes of uninterrupted meditation. You can spend Byakugou Seals to use battle techniques while in your Battle Medic state. As a Bonus Action, while you are in combat, you enter your Battle Medic combat state for the next minute. You cannot enter this state again until you spend 10 minutes recovering from the fatigue is brings. While in this state you can spend Byakugou Seals to use the following abilities.

Crimson Lotus Missile. When you cast a Taijutsu that makes a single attack, by spending 1 Byakugou Seal as part of the attack, you add the spent Yin Seal to the damage dealt and the affected creature and all creatures within 5 feet of it, excluding you must make a Strength saving throw vs your Taijutsu (or Ninjutsu) save DC. On a failure, they are knocked prone and Dazed.

Cherry Blossom Rush. When you take damage from an attack or Jutsu, you can spend your Reaction and 1 Byakugou Seal. When you do, roll the spent Yin seal, multiplying the result by 5. You can move a number of feet, up to the result and then you can to cast a Taijutsu with a casting time of 1 Action at the end of that movement.
